lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice superlatives for simple favorites and best choices.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues talk about the best fika snack, day, or weekend activity.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Naming a favorite or strongest preference.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik compare fika snacks, free-time activities, or weekdays and say what is best or most fun.

main_focus.name: superlatives for favorites
main_focus.description: Use common superlative forms to say which option is best, nicest, or most fun.
model_examples: Det roligaste är att träffa vänner.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use superlative forms naturally 3-5 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use superlatives in concrete choices a learner can reuse.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about a favorite or best option.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss two or three options and use superlatives to choose.
dialogue_shape.ending: They close by choosing or agreeing on one option.

target_complexity.repetition: spiral comparatives lightly but keep superlatives as the main focus

focus: the set of options being compared
the reason for the final preference

sentence_focus: one question with Vilken är bäst
one sentence with godast or roligast
